QUOTE: "Without the opt-out, `ctx->MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(state)` becomes `ctx->private_state`, so the real name `state` no longer exists. Plain `ctx->state` then fails to compile." and "Library sources that include `common.h` see the real field names."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer shows both branches of the `#ifndef`. Code that defines the opt-out sees plain member names, and ordinary consumers without it see the `private_` renamed ones.
